jobPostingInfo.title: DFT Intern - 2027
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
DFT focus on strategy definition through logic design and insertion, pre-silicon verification, pattern generation, and ATE bringup for NVIDIA chips, with special emphasis on ATE bringup, pattern/generation and validation, yield debug, failure analysis and volume diagnosis for ramp to production.


As a DFT intern at NVIDIA, you will help own the testing methodology from strategy definition through logic design and insertion, pre-silicon verification, pattern generation, and ATE bringup.


What you’ll be doing:

  • DFT logic implementation and verification
  • Maintain DFT flow and run regression
  • Run DFT verification
  • Pattern generation and bringup 

What we need to see: 

  • Strong logic design and verification background
  • Possess very basic knowledge of DFT 
  • Skilled in Perl/tcl programming
  • Proficient at Verilog HDL
  • Pursuing MS/PhD in EE

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Prefer to have experience with logic simulators and debug tools (such as vcs, ncsim, verdi)
  • Familiar with C/C , Makefile is a plus
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication skills and teamwork

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!
